entries.headline: USAF command jet and transports reported airborne
entries.summary: War Watch reported a U.S. Air Force nuclear-command aircraft airborne over the continental United States alongside multiple large transport aircraft and a presidential aircraft, describing the activity level as routine.

entries.headline: Times of India Iran oil-export report highlighted
entries.summary: War Watch highlighted a Times of India report saying the United States claimed Iran had lost $25 billion in oil exports to a naval blockade and could no longer fund proxy militias.

entries.headline: Coded USAF broadcast and five transports reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported one coded U.S. Air Force radio broadcast in the preceding hour and five military transport aircraft airborne over the United States, including one presidential aircraft.

entries.headline: Suspilne railway-bridge strike report highlighted
entries.summary: War Watch highlighted a Suspilne report that Ukraine’s Defence Forces struck a railway bridge over the Unecha River in Russia’s Bryansk region, and said two outlets had confirmed the report.

entries.headline: Six USAF heavy cargo aircraft reported airborne
entries.summary: War Watch reported six U.S. Air Force heavy cargo aircraft airborne across the Atlantic and North America, with no coded military radio broadcasts detected in the preceding hour.

entries.headline: Six USAF transports and a tanker reported airborne
entries.summary: War Watch reported six U.S. Air Force transport aircraft airborne, including multiple aircraft over the North Atlantic, along with one active refuelling tanker.

entries.headline: Six USAF cargo aircraft and other activity reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported six U.S. Air Force cargo aircraft airborne over the United States and also noted reports of overnight Ukrainian drone strikes toward Moscow and U.S. naval movements.

entries.headline: Reuters sanctions-and-tariffs report highlighted
entries.summary: War Watch highlighted a Reuters report that President Donald Trump waived many Russia-related sanctions and tariffs before a new law was to take effect, and said two outlets had confirmed the report.

entries.headline: Five USAF cargo aircraft reported airborne
entries.summary: War Watch reported five U.S. Air Force cargo aircraft airborne over the continental United States and elevated military flight activity across the region during the preceding six hours.

entries.headline: Ukrainian missile and drone raid into Russia relayed
entries.summary: War Watch relayed a reagan0965 report of an ongoing Friday-night Ukrainian missile and attack-drone raid into Russia, with drones targeting the Moscow area and passing to its west.

entries.headline: UKMTO Strait of Hormuz attack-count statement relayed
entries.summary: War Watch relayed a reagan0965 report quoting UKMTO as saying it was struggling to accurately report the true number of attacks in the Strait of Hormuz.

entries.headline: C-130J OTIS22 with hex AE6C1E spotted
entries.summary: War Watch reported a Lockheed Martin C-130J Super Hercules using callsign OTIS22, hex AE6C1E and registration 170282, citing a sighting by reagan0965 and a photo by Claude Davet via Planespotters.net.

entries.summary: SkyGlass highlighted a Defence Blog report that the U.S. Navy awarded Boeing up to $80 million to improve the MQ-25A Stingray drone.
